amendment_2026_10_26_active_recalibratio: EXPLICIT USER INSTRUCTION after 1.6 deployment: activate roster strength in the live motor and modify published probabilities, retrain with current-season statistics, audit all data and resolve encountered errors. Supersedes the shadow-only activation rule below. Fit uses the previous two full scored seasons PLUS all validated completed current-season games strictly before an explicit training cutoff; no unfinished, same-day or future outcome enters that fit. All validated regular, play-in and playoff boxes are consolidated, with postseason indicators in team and player calibration. Official repaired boxes close all 95 extended-count gaps: seconds :60 carry exactly, empty duplicate player stubs cannot overwrite real statistics, a recorded shot/free-throw attempt proves participation even at 0:00 without invented positive minutes. Individual strength (ridge 25, rotation weight 0.25 selected on 2024-25) is ACTIVE in winner, team points and total; its prior historical improvement remains inconclusive and is not relabeled as statistically proven. New completed games update portable strength online. Player rates follow official IDs; current-team minutes update role, low-sample roles have added variance, empirical weight shrinks with compatible history; calibration is refitted with minimum one real appearance and a postseason indicator, including rookies. Published changes are append-only revisions: source original, new model, data cutoff and actual recalculation timestamp are retained. A revision calculated after tipoff is clearly labeled and excluded from prospective accuracy statistics. It never acquires a fabricated pre-tipoff seal. Original hashes are not overwritten. Pending games refresh from current inputs; the initial full migration also recalculates earlier publications at their existing thresholds. Completion audit (same day): current-season boxes now carry fgm, ftm, fg3a, dreb, pf and plus-minus, so no consolidated column is missing; cached 1.4-1.6 boxes are downloaded again. Report names written as "Last, Jr., First" resolve to the official player. A recalculation identical to the previous version is discarded instead of stored; accuracy statistics count, per forecast, the newest version computed before tipoff (original or pre-tipoff update). Sealing new games runs before revisions, so a failed revision never delays a publication.
roster_strength_shadow: Optional prospective experiment, never part of forecasts or public probabilities: preseason individual ridge coefficients (ridge 25) and weight 0.25 selected on 2024-25, frozen with the model and code hash; current official membership and only earlier completed games form the rotation. Store reference, candidate, unknown minutes and turnover under roster_strength_shadow with experimental=true, accepted=false and affects_published_forecasts=false. The historical acceptance test failed; no production strength adjustment is enabled by collecting this experiment.
amendment_2026_10_26_official_rosters: User request: correct summer transfers and recalibrate the live model. A model with options.official_rosters=true obtains each game's two current official NBA team rosters (at most 1 hour old, correct season and team/player IDs). Raw pages, actual first receipt and hashes are archived and pinned in the sealed bundle. A player belongs to the official current team even before his first appearance there; the personal statistical history follows the player ID across teams. Departed players are excluded even when their last appearance or an old book quote names the old team. Membership does not establish participation or minutes. Conflicting injury entries are excluded and counted. Missing/stale/ambiguous official rosters stop sealing rather than reverting to old membership. A separate individual-strength candidate was selected on 2024-25 and evaluated on 2025-26 under nba_roster_strength_protocol.json: it did NOT pass the declared acceptance criterion and is not applied to team forecasts. Existing team coefficients and player calibration remain identical after the membership-module refit. Older sealed cohorts retain their original version and evidence.
amends: nba-multimarket-research-1.3 (retrospective); RUN071 (v1.1, 42 sealed forecasts) sealed and untouched
amendment_2026_10_23: docs/nba_auditoria_motor_20261023.md; the team model and the availability rule are unchanged; new markets and game types are in player_markets and game_types. (1) cohorts: the producer seals each game in the first run that finds its tipoff more than 65 and at most 90 minutes ahead, so games before 17:35 ET are no longer skipped and every game can get a report that still counts; (2) sealed_at_utc and every receipt are stamped when they happen, not when the run started; (3) finished games come from a cache and a past game not final stops the seal; (4) a 403/404 report slot is checked once against a control file, so a blocked source stops the seal instead of passing for 'no report'; (5) player values for availability include the target season's box scores. Cohorts sealed before this amendment keep version nba-multimarket-live-1.3.
amendment_2026_10_25: amendment 2026-10-25 (user decision: retrain and calibrate with the new data and deploy; docs/nba_productor_14_20261025.md). Decided piece by piece by apps/nba/nba_live14_protocol.json (frozen before running; fit as if the target were 2025-26, scored on 2025-26 on identical units). ACCEPTED: (1) the fit reads the old reports plus the T-60 backfill (pooled player Brier -0.0018, all seven markets better); (2) environment features in the player calibration (total_c, own_spread, abs_spread, home, back_to_back, pace_c, opp_def_c, min10, usage_trend; pooled -0.0003, all seven better); with the RUN071 data pace_c, opp_def_c and usage_trend are constant 0 in training, so their weights stay 0 and the gain comes from the lines, home, rest and minutes; the lines are bet365 45 minutes before tipoff in training and the PropLine consensus main line at sealing (spread of the home side, total), 0 when missing; (3) new markets player_threes, player_steals, player_blocks and player_blocks_steals (live calibration beats the raw law, slope 0.99-1.00). REJECTED: the extended dataset with play-in and playoffs (pooled +0.0004, worse in rebounds, assists and their sums), the in-season team scoring shift (+0.0010 in team points) and player_turnovers (no turnover counts in the accepted data). The fit uses options stored in model.json (features, team_shift_n0 = null, markets); a model without options is read as 1.3.2. Box-score rows now carry threes, steals, blocks, turnovers, shot attempts and offensive rebounds; cache entries written by 1.3.x are downloaded again.
amendment_2026_10_24: amendment 2026-10-24 (user decision, docs/nba_productor_combinaciones_20261024.md): adds points+rebounds, points+assists, rebounds+assists and points+rebounds+assists over the PropLine consensus line, conditional on playing, with the same law, the same live calibration over the LINE_OFFSETS grid and the same availability features as the single counts; the prior rate per minute of a sum is the sum of the parts (0.85, 0.80, 0.35, 1.00). Pre-registered check (apps/nba/nba_live_combos_protocol.json, frozen before running): the live fit run as if the target season were 2025-26 beats the raw law with the upper bound of the 98.75% interval below 0, with test slope in [0.9, 1.1] and |intercept| <= 0.10, for each of the four sums. A model fitted before this amendment has no weights for the new markets and the producer leaves them out instead of guessing. Team markets, the availability rule, the seal rule and everything else are unchanged; cohorts sealed under 1.3.1 are untouched. The module hash changes, so a new model.json must be fitted before sealing.
markets_not_included: turnovers (no turnover counts in the accepted training data) and double-double (no line semantics); cohorts sealed before 2026-10-23 have team markets only and cohorts sealed before 2026-10-24 have no summed markets
player_markets: amendment 2026-10-23 (user decision): points, rebounds and assists, conditional on playing (a player who does not take the floor is 'dnp' and not scored, as books void the prop). Universe and threshold come from the shared hourly PropLine archive (newest observation at most 65 min old at seal time, read offline): players whose full-game main Over/Under at a half point is quoted by at least 2 sportsbooks; DFS sites, exchanges and flagged quotes never count; the threshold is the most common line (ties: nearest the median, then the lower). Prices are not a model input. Model = the retrospective v1.3 player model: negative binomial + 0.25 empirical mixture over the last 20 games (370 days, at least 10), logistic recalibration on [logit p, 1, own Questionable/Doubtful, own Probable, teammates' expected missing minutes / 48], fitted once on 2024-25 and 2025-26 and stored in model.json. Unlike the retrospective run, the recalibration is fitted over thresholds floor(mean of last 10)+0.5 + (-4,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+4), because a book line can sit anywhere: out of sample (train 2023-25, test 2025-26) the single-threshold fit was off by 5-8 points of over-rate two to four lines away, and the grid improved the overall Brier of all three markets. Players listed Out are not forecast; the player's team is his last box-score team and must be in the game.
game_types: amendment 2026-10-23: regular season (002), play-in (005), playoffs (004) and the NBA Cup final (006) are sealed and their results feed ratings, rest and form; preseason and All-Star never.
model: multimarket_v13.team_predictions fitted once on the two scored seasons before the target season (2024-25, 2025-26); parameters stored in model.json and applied unchanged to every live cohort
schedule_source: https://www.nba.com/games?date=D (cards) and https://www.nba.com/game/<slug> (tipoff, ids, team names); one cohort = games of one Eastern date still not started at seal time (producer: only those whose tipoff is 65-90 minutes ahead)
completed_games: finished games of the target season (box score page, status final) are fed to ratings, rest and recent form, and their player rows to the availability values; none are invented
availability_rule: a report counts for a game only if its own timestamp AND our first receipt are both at least 60 minutes before tipoff; latest valid report wins; otherwise the game is sealed as 'sin_reporte_valido' with zero availability features (same as an unobserved game in v1.3)
identity: player = unique exact normalized name among players with history; team = team name in the report; players without 5 games of history in the last 370 days carry no feature
team_of_player: team named in the report (rosters changed in the offseason; the retrospective run used last box-score team)
seal_rule: sealed_at_utc (taken when the bundle is written) strictly before tipoff; one folder per cohort, bundle.json hashed in bundle.seal.json; never overwritten
results: official NBA box score page captured after the game, final status, identity and tipoff exactly as sealed; a receipt that is not final is discarded and retried
scoring: Brier and log loss of winner, team points over reference line, game total over reference line; descriptive only, no promotion
